pages.text: Cave carrots are a protein-rich subspecies of ordinary carrots that has adapted to cave environment.$(p)When you uproot ordinary carrot crops where skylight is completely blocked, their seeds have a $(bold)70% chance$() to become cave carrot seeds.

Plant the seeds on $(l:mechanics/crops)farmland$() and provide suitable temperatures and $(l:mechanics/hydration)hydration$(). Cave carrots grow under the same conditions as ordinary carrots:$(br2)$(bold)Temperature: 3–30°C; hydration: 25–100%$().
pages.title: Grow Cave Carrots

pages.text: Cave carrots draw $(bold)potassium$() from the soil. A good supply improves growth and harvests.$(br2)Harvest mature crops to gather cave carrots and recover seeds for replanting.
Eat cave carrots fresh or heat them into baked cave carrots. They are also essential ingredients for many miner's dishes.
